e22-co542-Air-Pollution-Forecasting-Usin.title: Air Pollution Forecasting Using Temporal NNs Team VectorX
e22-co542-Air-Pollution-Forecasting-Usin.description: An end-to-end deep learning and machine learning framework for hourly PM2.5 air pollution forecasting across 12 Beijing monitoring stations, leveraging physics-informed atmospheric feature engineering, deep residual temporal neural networks (ResNet-1D BiLSTM), and SLSQP hybrid ensemble blending.
